svg.title: SC-1 Outrider floor layout test 1
svg.text: SC-1 Outrider · conduit ring · glow style
Rooms run from 1x1 to 4x4 tiles and can hold
The bridge holds three single-tile systems:
The core sits mid-ship under the armour, and
Glowing line: a powered conduit on the
floor. Chevrons show power flowing from
Gap with sparks: a cut conduit. Power
still reaches every system the other way
Grey console with its switch left: a
Capped stub: a tap reserved for a system
Blue bar: a door. Dashed room: a spare
